meta.name: Bass Tunnel
meta.description: An infinite tunnel of concentric ring outlines receding toward the center. Each ring is a closed polyline laid on a circle (true outline, not a filled disc) using the aspect idiom so it stays round on any window. A scrolling depth var pushes the rings inward; their spacing and scale pulse smoothly with a low-band-smoothed var so the tunnel breathes with the bass. Hue shifts with depth and feedback adds a soft depth glow. Silence slows the scroll and dims the rings to a calm, near-still tunnel.
meta.author: ViewMusic built-in
